intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Charleston for 2026, and here is what he found: 25 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (Holiday Festival of Lights) through December 31, with Light the Lake at Colonial Lake (December 4), the Charleston Holiday Parade and Tree Lighting (December 6) and Charleston's Nutcracker at the Sottile Theatre (December 18) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Charleston

  • 25 Christmas events for kids in Charleston
  • 8 free events, including Light the Lake at Colonial Lake, the Charleston Holiday Parade and Tree Lighting at Marion Square and The Charleston Santa at the Best Friend Train Museum
  • Meet Santa: The Charleston Santa at the Best Friend Train Museum, the South Carolina Aquarium, American Gardens, James Island County Park and the Brunch with Santa Cruise on the Charleston Princess
  • Lights and tree lightings: Holiday Festival of Lights, Aquarium Aglow, Light the Lake and the Daniel Island Tree Lighting
  • Shows: A Christmas Carol, A Charlie Brown Christmas, the Charleston Christmas Special and two Nutcracker productions
  • Season: November 13 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Charleston families also use our town pages for Summerville, North Charleston, Goose Creek, Mount Pleasant and Edisto Beach, each with its own Christmas events for kids.
